summary: EcoSpace (Abandoned but not Forgotten) is an interactive 3D web experience that transforms retired NASA space missions into a living digital museum. Through an immersive journey across the Solar System, users visit the exact resting places of historic spacecraft on the Moon, Mars, and deep space, inspecting accurate 3D models while reliving their mission logs, scientific milestones, and final stories to preserve the human legacy of space exploration.
details:
EcoSpace is an interactive 3D web application that functions as a living digital museum dedicated to historic NASA space missions that have completed their operational lifecycles. Through a single, immersive visual environment with zero page reloads, users navigate the Solar System to visit the exact resting places of iconic spacecraft and rovers on the Moon (Eagle, Surveyor 3), Mars (Opportunity, Pathfinder, InSight, Ingenuity), and deep space (Pioneer 10). Upon selecting each destination, the camera smoothly transitions toward detailed 3D models, allowing users to inspect the engineering of each vehicle while displaying its historical log, scientific discoveries, and the narrative of its final moments.

What It Offers:

  • Universal Accessibility: Running directly in the web browser without heavy downloads or specialized hardware, any student, educator, or enthusiast can explore our space heritage from a desktop computer or mobile device.
  • Visual and Emotional Learning: It transforms complex technical data, telemetry, and historical NASA reports into an intuitive visual storytelling experience that makes scientific concepts easier to understand.
  • Preservation of Space Memory: It rescues pioneering missions from being forgotten, highlighting the human and technological value behind every exploration.

With this project, we aim to carry forward the legacy left behind by these robotic companions so that their stories are never forgotten.

Languages and Technologies Used:

  • Frontend & Web Architecture: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite.
  • 3D Engine & Web Graphics: Three.js and React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber) for real-time spatial rendering, lighting, and smooth camera transitions.
  • 3D Modeling & Optimization Pipeline: Python and Blender for custom asset automation, mesh optimization, and GLB/USDZ model generation.n

Our project is creative because it includes dynamic 3D interactions; this way, the user not only enjoys a fully interactive 3D environment but can also observe small, intriguing details throughout the 3D space—from the dynamic shadows cast by the sun to the tiny red spots on its surface, which reflect the plasma ejections it emits, but you can also relive the stories of all our friendly robots so that they are not forgotten—instead, a deep memory of them remains etched directly in our hearts as we interact with this project. We took many important factors into account, such as real-world scientific development based on scientific data for the 3D modeling.
